faq.heading: Questions, answered without a smile
faq.intro: The joke is the gift. The answers should still be plain.
faq.seoTitle: Gift Kit FAQ | Make Your Own Crap
faq.seoDescription: Answers about Make Your Own Crap kits: who builds them, what is in the box, shipping, alcohol, and checkout.

items.q: So they have to build it?
items.a: Yes. That is the gift. The parts make something real. The recipient does the assembly.

items.q: Is this Make Your Own Damn Candle?
items.a: Same people, same idea, different shelf. Make Your Own Damn Candle was the candle. This is where the format goes next.
Parts and instructions. Each product page lists what that kit includes. The recipient does the building.
Each kit says so, as a difficulty line and a snark level. Snark is how much the gift teases them. Difficulty is how much work is in the box. Neither one is a dare to do something unsafe.

items.q: Do you ship alcohol in the bitters kit?
items.a: No. The bitters kit is botanicals, bottles, and instructions. If a recipe needs high-proof alcohol, they buy that locally.
A separate shipping price is not listed. Kits are mailed inside the United States. The amount on the kit page is the amount listed for the kit.
The buy button says coming soon until a payment link is on that kit. The cart holds the details in this browser. Leave your email and we will be in touch.
Then you liked them about the right amount. For money, read the refund page.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: You want to send something nice. You also think they can handle a small project. The kit is both. A real result, and the work required to get there.

sections.heading: The lineup
sections.body: Six kits: a candle, hot sauce, a terrarium, a birdhouse, soap, and cocktail bitters. Each page lists what is in the box.

sections.heading: Where the shop is
sections.body: The business is in Grayson, Louisiana. That is the address on the record. It is not a claim that a factory tour is available.

privacy.heading: What this site stores
privacy.intro: How this site handles the address you type, the cart in your browser, and a simple page view.
privacy.seoTitle: Privacy Policy | Make Your Own Crap
privacy.seoDescription: How Make Your Own Crap handles the address you type, the cart saved in your browser, and the page view sent to our own server.

sections.heading: What you type
sections.body: A ship-to address, an optional note, and an optional email. Those are for sending a kit and answering you. There is no account.

sections.heading: This browser
sections.body: The cart and a notify-me note stay in local storage on this device. They are not uploaded by that form. Clearing the browser clears them.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Card numbers are not entered here. When a kit has a payment link, the button sends you there, with the details you typed added to the link. That page belongs to the payment provider.

sections.heading: Page views
sections.body: Opening a page sends a note to our own server with the path and the referrer. It is not an advertising network. We do not sell a list.

sections.heading: Email
sections.body: Leave your email on the contact page or with a coming-soon note. We will be in touch. The cart itself stays on this device.

refunds.heading: If something is wrong
refunds.intro: A kit is parts and instructions. This is how we handle a problem before it ships, and a mistake that is ours.
refunds.seoDescription: Refunds for Make Your Own Crap kits. Reach us before a kit ships to cancel. A started project is not a refund.

sections.heading: Before it ships
sections.body: If you reach us before a kit ships, we cancel the order and return the payment.

sections.heading: Unopened
sections.body: An unopened kit can be returned. Contact the shop and we will tell you where to send it.

sections.heading: Already building
sections.body: A kit they have started is parts they have used. We replace anything we packed wrong. A project they did not enjoy is not a refund.
